title: Calendar event time normalisation
purpose: Define explicit, testable rules for presenting a calendar event instant in a consumer-selected timezone without treating editorial title text as an implicit source of truth.
constraints: Preserve the provider event instant before any display conversion.
Require an explicit IANA consumer timezone for local presentation.
Treat a time embedded in a title as editorial metadata unless an approved contract explicitly selects it.
Do not silently overwrite a provider timestamp, infer a timezone, or change recurrence semantics.
